title: JupyterLab Run Python Settings
description: Settings for the JupyterLab Run Python extension.

defaultPythonCommand.title: Default Python command
defaultPythonCommand.description: Interpreter command used when no kernel mapping is found.

kernelCommandMap.title: Kernel command map
kernelCommandMap.description: Map from kernel name to shell command template.

showRunButtonInEditor.title: Show Run button in editor toolbar

recentArgsPresets.title: Recent args presets by file
recentArgsPresets.description: Map of script path to a recent list of args strings.

serverRootPath.title: Jupyter server root filesystem path
serverRootPath.description: Absolute filesystem path that corresponds to Jupyter contents root (for example /home/jovyan). Used to build absolute script paths.
